units: <cite ref="Shabbat 86b:5">Sabb. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ הדברות</he> the ten words (commandments); a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲשָׂרוֹת</he>, <he>עֲשָׂרִיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 18a:3">Snh. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>שרי ע׳ ששת רבוא</he> the number of the chiefs of ten (<cite ref="Exodus 18:21">Ex. XVIII, 21</cite>) was sixty thousand; Mekh. Yithro, ʿĂmal., s. 2; Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Exodus 6">Mishp. 6</cite>. Tanḥ. Emor 24 (Chald. dict.) <he>זיל כנוש עֲשָׂרִיּוֹתֶיךָ</he> go and gather thy divisions of ten.
